nodes.text: What cosmic forces, nourishment, and intelligences did Gurdjieff teach?

anchors.quote: shapes colors motion texture etc all have composable meanings

nodes.text: A small generating set of shape, color, motion, and texture could support compositional visual meanings.

anchors.quote: ok i havent reviewed this yet but does/how does consicousness, consciousnes experience decisions/will, logic, existence/reality play into this

nodes.text: How should consciousness, experience, will, logic, and existence be expressed in the interlingua?

anchors.quote: to me a conscious subject is somethign capable of being aware of an experience.

nodes.text: A conscious subject can be understood as something capable of awareness of an experience, although competing distinctions should remain expressible.

anchors.quote: i have my own beliefs but am not tryin g to impose them ont he interlingua becuase it should be able to represnt different beleif tpes.

nodes.text: The interlingua should express incompatible belief systems without imposing its author's metaphysical convictions.

nodes.text: Moral agency, including the possibility that moral agents exist, must be expressible without assuming Dennett's own commitments.

anchors.quote: ok we should keep in mind that we may need kind of arbitrary symbols or whatever eventually for some things.

nodes.text: The visual grammar may need iconic depiction and learned conventional symbols in addition to compositional primitives.

anchors.quote: i approve
